name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd
description: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd (APSEZ) is India's largest commercial port operator and integrated transport utility, handling approximately 27% of India's total port cargo throughput. With 15 domestic ports and terminals across 7 coastal states (anchored by flagship Mundra Port) and international terminals in Sri Lanka (Colombo), Israel (Haifa), and Tanzania, APSEZ delivers end-to-end marine, rail freight, and multi-modal logistics corridors.

company_profile.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd (APSEZ) is India's largest commercial port operator and integrated transport utility, handling approximately 27% of India's total port cargo throughput. With 15 domestic ports and terminals across 7 coastal states (anchored by flagship Mundra Port) and international terminals in Sri Lanka (Colombo), Israel (Haifa), and Tanzania, APSEZ delivers end-to-end marine, rail freight, and multi-modal logistics corridors.

revenue_breakup.desc: Container stevedoring, dry bulk cargo handling, liquid chemicals, crude berthing, and pilotage fees.
110+ container trains, grade-A warehousing hubs, agri-silos, and inland container depots (ICDs).
Industrial land leasing, port utility connections, and dredging infrastructure.

moats_and_strengths: Dominant market share (27% of national cargo) with deepest draft berths capable of handling Capesize vessels.
Flagship Mundra Port is India's largest commercial port by volume, surpassing 180 MMT annual throughput.
Integrated logistics backbone with dedicated railway lines directly linking coastal ports to the northern hinterland.
Industry-leading port EBITDA margins (>65%) backed by high asset utilization and automated container terminals.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Total Cargo Throughput: 420+ MMT annually • Target Capacity: 500+ MMT by 2025 • 15 Strategic Ports

bullish_triggers: Commissioning of the deepwater Colombo West International Terminal in Sri Lanka capturing Indian transshipment cargo.
Rapid volume ramp-up of the Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) shifting bulk traffic from road to Adani rail.
Expanding containerization rate in India from 17% towards global average of 30%.
bearish_risks: Geopolitical volatility affecting international transit trade at the Port of Haifa.
Sensitivity to global trade slowdowns and container shipping freight rate corrections.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
